propositions: Negative caplog assertions (assert not ...) pass vacuously when zero records arrive, providing no signal that coverage was lost

Logger propagation set to False and logger level raised to WARNING process-globally by configure_logging() and CLI entrypoints persist across tests, causing downstream caplog assertions to silently capture nothing
Void assertions are undetectable from test output; a green run provides no evidence whether five identified negative assertions actually verified anything
An autouse fixture guard that snapshots and restores logger propagation state and level at test boundaries prevents silent void assertions and catches poisoning at its source
Two independent poisoning vectors exist: propagate=False (removed in b718) and level raised to WARNING (contained by the guard via restore), neither overlaps the other's fix
